column1: # Sign segmentation golden set (deterministic synthetic landmarks; no model, no device).
# Scenario header: window | stride | motionThreshold | frameCount | motionStartInclusive | motionEndExclusive
# The canonical stream is SegmenterFixtures.stream(frameCount) { index ->
#   if (index in [motionStart, motionEnd)) MOTION_STEP * index else 0f }.
# Cadence: a boundary slot occurs at consumed == windowSize then every stride frames. The gate is
# skipped (without shifting cadence) for the motionless leading window and the motionless trailing window.
